title: WolfTrek cockpit (Starfold): Glass Arc console, ground panel, Station window, guide, setup helper
layout_order: flying: over the view the reticle, pitch ladder, heading tape and target box, the AUTOMATIC DOCKING banner at the top; the Glass Arc console along the bottom: LEFT class + three arcs (SHIELD/ARMOUR/HULL) with words | CENTRE speed, THROTTLE line, throttle strip, FIRE MINE NEXT TARGET DOCK FLY THERE, small row: [left] STEADY/DRIFT STATION BELT WORMHOLE STOP, [right] ? PANEL HIDE LEAVE SHIP BASE | RIGHT HOLD/Starmarks, TARGET line, elliptical radar, wolf mark; notes and the hint above the console; hidden: SHOW COCKPIT tab bottom centre. Not flying: ground band (name, words | TO THE PAD, TO THE STATION, LAUNCH, GUIDE, CLOSE). Docked: Station window centred (title/RENAME STATION, Docked line, MARKET table, Starmarks + STARBASE, SELL ALL ORE ... CLOSE, LAUNCH). Guide card centred; setup helper on the right. Ship tabs: SHIPYARD rows; HANGAR: YOUR SHIPS / YOUR OWN DESIGNS (designs and builds on the left, the MAKE YOUR OWN SHIP guide with USE MY OWN BUILD on the right). Flying: SCAN over the big row's right end beside the radar, the SCAN: result line top left above the console.
